pages.text: Eager to launch into the final frontier? We totally get the enthusiasm but you can't just hurl yourself into space and hope to survive! $(thing)Preparation$() is key to survival, or you'll just end up back in the Stone Age banging rocks together for a few seconds before suffocating to death.

Make sure you have at least the following:$(li)A $(item)Space Suit$() and a full drum of breathable gas$(li)A $(item)Rocket$() with another full drum of spare $(thing)Fuel$()$(li)A second $(item)Launch Pad$() so you can return$(li)Plenty of food and water$(li)A weapon and shield in case the Moon's haunted...
Consider bringing along some $(thing)Space Food$() for the journey ahead! It's simple to make and comes with a long shelf life.

$(l:cooking/decay#freeze_dry)Freeze-Dried Fruits$() are a tasty snack, $(item)Meal Bags$() can hold any normal kind of food you'd have on Earth, and there's also $(item)Calorie Paste$() for a nutritionally complete but gross meal. You can reuse the Foil Packs when you're finished, too!
